title: K1733 split stage 1/2: full-replicate production run -> K1733_results.json

claude_followup.brief:
K1733 split stage 2/2 — VERIFY + MERGE (stage 1 = k1733-split-stage1-full-run produced experiments/k1733/K1733_results.json inside worktree .claude/worktrees/dispatch-slot-1-9189c746-k1733; branch k1733-slot1-9189c746). Stage 1 was compute-only and did NOT verify anything. Do all of the following, in the worktree, and do NOT trust the README until it is reconciled against the fresh JSON.
(0) FRESHNESS GATE: assert config.quick_mode == false and reproduce_spec exists in K1733_results.json. The parent job (agent-brief_k1733-b39c59) timed out before ever writing this artifact, and a 2026-07-30 scratch --quick run showed finalize_experiment writes the JSON BEFORE hashing reproduce_spec inputs — so a JSON without reproduce_spec means the run crashed at the end and must be re-run, not collected.
(1) README RECONCILIATION (the crux): experiments/k1733/README.md section 7 was written from an in-agent run whose results.json was never persisted. Check EVERY number in README against the fresh JSON: H1-H4 test statistics, p-values, post-FDR conclusions, ordering_robustness sign-stability rates, and any with-cost results. Any mismatch -> correct the README to the JSON (the JSON is the computed truth) and record the correction. A 2026-07-30 quick-mode reproduction already matched the README verdict set (H1 ACCEPT / H2 REJECT / H2R_post_hoc PARTIAL_POST_HOC / H3 REJECT / H4 NOT_RUN_PRECONDITION_NOT_MET), so qualitative agreement is expected — but full-replicate p-values and magnitudes WILL differ from quick mode and are the numbers that must land.
(2) LOOKAHEAD: K1733.py must carry an explicit signal.shift(1) or equivalent lag, and lookahead_diagnostics (the future-noise causal probe) violations must be empty.
(3) METHODOLOGY RED LINE (K628b/K865b): every directional claim must rest on order-invariant KPPS GFEVD, with ordering-robustness sign stability >= 90%. If any directional conclusion is supported by Cholesky-ordered FEVD -> verdict FAIL. Note H2 is REJECT and H2R is only PARTIAL_POST_HOC: confirm the README states the post-hoc mirror as post-hoc and does not promote it to a pre-registered finding.
(4) Nested forecast comparison must use Clark-West, not Diebold-Mariano.
(5) H4 must remain NOT_RUN: its pre-registered gate was "run only if H2 or H3 is ACCEPT/PARTIAL"; both are REJECT, so h4_strategy must be null. If h4_strategy is populated, that is post-hoc fishing -> FAIL.
(6) Run: uv run python scripts/check_experiment_artifacts.py check --path experiments/k1733 (confirms the run-time-generated reproduce_spec and the three-piece set).
(7) Codex code review of K1733.py before the results are trusted; also run experiments/k1733/test_k1733.py (18 tests).
(8) MAIN THREAD writes storage/memory/knowledge.json — agents must not (K1259) — and numbers must be extracted programmatically from K1733_results.json, never retyped.
(9) MERGE: bash scripts/merge_worktree.sh dispatch-slot-1-9189c746-k1733 (via canonical git_writer_lock run). Leave no unmerged branch/worktree.
(10) HOUSEKEEPING: a second, older K1733 worktree dispatch-slot-1-1e5922b4-k1733 (age ~57h, unmerged=0, dirty=0) is a stale duplicate from an earlier attempt — reconcile/remove it so the K1733 task-id collision gate is clean.
